The $4 Soda

Read the script

A four-dollar soda feels totally fine on a beach vacation, and outrageous from your own fridge. Same soda, same four dollars. The only thing that changed is what it sat next to.

People can't judge a price on its own. They judge it against whatever's nearby. And your price isn't being weighed on its merits either. It's being weighed against the cheap guy's quote, a DIY video, a "my brother-in-law could probably do it." You can't see what's sitting next to you in their head, but it's setting your price for you. More leads won't fix that. Each one is comparing you to something you can't see.

You're not short on leads. You're short on calls. So what's sitting next to your price in your prospect's mind right now?
